title: OHIF pluginConfig.json
description: Build-time plugin declaration for platform/app. Every extension/mode bundled into the viewer must be declared here; presence in the extensions/ or modes/ workspace folders alone does nothing.

root.description: Base for this file's './'-relative `directory` values, and the tree scanned for in-tree extensions/ and modes/ workspaces. Resolved against the directory holding this file. Omit it (the default) to use the OHIF repo root, which is what the in-tree config's values mean. Set it in a config owned by a downstream deployment and selected with PLUGIN_CONFIG / an OHIF_ENV profile, e.g. "." for a config sitting at the root of your own repo.

packageName.description: npm package name of the extension or mode (also its OHIF id).

default.description: false keeps the plugin resolvable/bundled but not auto-registered at startup.

directory.description: Out-of-tree package root. Leading './' is repo-root-relative, leading '~' is home-relative, anything else is absolute. Use forward slashes.
Asset folder copied verbatim into dist. Same path grammar as plugin.directory.

packageName.description: npm package name of the third-party package. Interpolated into the generated pluginImports.js, hence the same name grammar as plugin.packageName.

importPath.description: URL/path passed to window.browserImportFunction for runtime import. Interpolated into a single-quoted JS string literal by the codegen, so the charset excludes quotes, backslashes, and newlines.

globalName.description: window global to read after importPath loads (UMD-style). Interpolated into generated JS, so the charset excludes quotes, backslashes, and newlines.

importName.description: Named export to use instead of default when globalName is not set. Interpolated into generated JS, so it must be a plain JS identifier.

to.description: Sub-path under dist to copy directory into, e.g. /dicom-microscopy-viewer/.
